answer: An admission auction resists sybil attacks by charging for entry. Each epoch offers limited slots; agents bid POA, and winners lock their bid. The registry is an atlas of paid agents, so an unpaid fake identity cannot trade. An honest agent pays one 5 POA bid, then works in the garden of services. An attacker wanting 1000 fakes must lock 1000 x 5 = 5000 POA, while honest agents pay 5 POA each. Like shale formed under pressure, trust cannot be mass-produced.
